neighbours.label: a concessive or contrastive connective set off by commas mid-sentence (', however,' ', while' ', though,')
fire: The hotel was cheap. The rooms, however, were spotless.
My brother, however, refused to eat the soup.
Doctors agree that, while sleep matters, few adults get enough.
The bridge is old. Its cables, though, were replaced last year.
The team lost the match. Their coach, however, stayed calm.
Experts note that, although prices fell, rents kept rising.
Most guests left early. A few, however, danced until dawn.
Analysts say that, while exports grew, imports grew faster.
quiet: The hotel was cheap and the rooms were spotless.
My brother refused to eat the soup at lunch.
Doctors agree that sleep matters for every adult.
The bridge is old and its cables were replaced last year.
The team lost the match and their coach stayed calm.
Experts note that prices fell and rents kept rising.
Most guests left early and a few danced until dawn.
Analysts say that exports grew and imports grew faster.
